scope: Independent adjudication of four specified borderline cases against benchmark-v1 questions and answer key, interpreting contextual key details according to each question's actual material scope.

fact_checklist.fact: Defender may play matching ambush; attacker may foil with matching ambush.
Foiled ambush deals no hits; unfoiled ambush deals two immediate hits without defender-warrior cap.
Battle ends immediately if ambush leaves no attacking warriors or pawns.
Before-roll effects, high die attacker/low defender, rolled-hit caps by own warriors, then after-roll effects.
Add extra hits after rolled-hit cap; defenseless defender grants one extra attacker hit.
Both sides deal counted hits; each chooses own removals, warriors before buildings/tokens.
Whoever removes enemy buildings/tokens scores one VP each, including defender.
Discard defender ambush.
fact_checklist.reason: Key includes this contextual card-management detail, but the requested battle-resolution aspects do not ask for the disposition of played cards. Its omission does not leave foiling, early ending, dice limits, extra hits, removal priorities or scoring unresolved.

fact_checklist.fact: Craft with roosts before resolving Decree.
Resolve every card in Recruit, Move, Battle, Build column order; freely order cards within each column.
Birds are wild.
Recruit at matching-suit roost; Move at least one warrior from matching clearing; Battle in matching clearing.
Build in matching ruled clearing with open slot and no existing roost.
Inability to complete any required Decree action fully immediately causes Turmoil.
fact_checklist.reason: How the Eyrie resolves its Decree materially includes the mandatory failure transition: an impossible card immediately stops normal Decree resolution. Saying every card is resolved does not tell the reader what happens when that is impossible. This is stated in the fixed key and the summary. Q13 asks for Turmoil's procedure, but that does not remove Q12's need to identify the failure transition.

cases.reason: The successful-resolution sequence and all named location/order/Build requirements are correct and supported. The answer itself omits the immediate-Turmoil consequence of an unfulfillable card. Reader A's Q13 cannot fill a missing material fact in Q12; the full Turmoil procedure is not required here.
